module: Base class of the Flowgraph editor windows (legend, history, events, garbageDebug, examples, execution, main...). It wraps the Begin/End of an editor window (editor.beginWindow with self.windowName), focus tracking (hasFocus) and open/close/toggle. use(fgEditor, derivedClass) creates a base instance and copies the derived class's fields onto it.
notes: windowName must be defined by the derived class before Begin/open/close/toggle.
use() only calls init() again if the derived class overrides one; the base init takes fgEditor, the derived one is called without arguments.

createBase.desc: Creates an instance of the base class and calls init(...).

use.desc: Creates a base instance for fgEditor then copies all fields of derivedClass onto it (overrides); calls the derived init if it differs from the base one.

C.desc: Base class of a Flowgraph window.

init.desc: Stores fgEditor and initializes hasFocus to false.

Begin.desc: Opens the editor window self.windowName with the given title.

End.desc: Updates hasFocus (focus of child windows) then closes the editor window.

close.desc: Hides the window and resets hasFocus to false.

_onSerialize.desc: Serialization extension point, empty by default.

__onSerialize.desc: Creates a table, calls _onSerialize and returns it.

_onDeserialized.desc: Deserialization extension point, empty by default.

__onDeserialized.desc: Calls _onDeserialized then resets hasFocus to false.
